Prioritize documented music-related connections that help layout organization: associated genres, shared members, collaborations, influences, instruments and clear bridges to neighboring zones. Active bridge policies for this zone: rock-to-metal, punk-to-rock, hip-hop-crossovers. Prefer candidates that strengthen those transitions without turning category pages into nodes.
